title: ChatGPT + Zapier

body.text: — build automations like: email arrives → AI summarizes → send to Slack, or a new form → AI drafts a reply → save to Sheets.

example: "Zap: when there's a new customer review in Google Forms → ChatGPT analyzes sentiment → notify the team in Slack if it's a bad review"

title: Design automations that work

body.text: — start with daily repetitive tasks, write the prompt in the Zap clearly like instructing a new employee, and test on real data before turning it on.

example: "Trigger: a new email containing 'quote' → AI extracts company, product, budget → Action: add a row in Google Sheets"
